answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the kernel until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ocean of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the lotus of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
